notes: A clothing size standing on its own in Korean text. AI Hub 159 size references read XL as 엑스라지 (41 of 43; 엑스엘 twice, both programme titles) and XS as 엑스스몰 (8 of 13), which the letter-by-letter initialism reading missed. A multiplier (3XL 쓰리 엑스라지) is read by the apparel-size rule. Authored 2026-09-30.
